title: karpathy/micrograd: a small autograd engine you can read
friendlyTitle: karpathy/micrograd: a tiny learning library you can read in an afternoon
summary: micrograd is Andrej Karpathy's teaching library: about 100 lines for scalar backpropagation, and about 50 for a small neural-net API with a PyTorch-like shape. It is on GitHub's Jupyter Notebook trending list, and the repository has about 18,200 stars. The license is MIT.
friendlySummary: micrograd is Andrej Karpathy's teaching library. About 100 lines do the backpropagation. About 50 more lines make a small neural-net API that looks a bit like PyTorch. It is on GitHub's Jupyter Notebook trending list. The repository has about 18,200 stars. The license is MIT.
whyItMatters: Install it with pip and run the demo notebook to train a two-layer classifier on the moons dataset. It is for seeing how a gradient is built, not for serving a model. The README also points to microgpt, a single-file GPT-style trainer built on the same idea.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Install it with pip and open the demo notebook to train a small two-layer classifier. It is for seeing how a gradient is built, not for running a production model. The README also points to microgpt, a single-file GPT-style trainer built on the same idea.
